answers.q1: Mostly one surface, but not fully: the small pill-shaped control bar at the very top (pause, comment, expand, more, stop) floats above and overlaps the main panel's top edge with its own shadow, so it reads like a separate floating toolbar sitting on top of the window rather than a built-in part of it. The main body below (left meeting/notes column + right transcript column + bottom input bar) does read as one continuous card.
answers.q2: Only partially. It shows '23:32 の会議' (a time-stamped generic label) and says it is recording/listening, but there is no meeting title, calendar name, participant list, or document name — 'AI が見ている資料' (materials AI is looking at) is shown with no actual material listed, so the source it is drawing from is not identifiable.
answers.q3: It is actively recording and listening (録音中 00:02, 聞いています...), but nothing has been said yet — the transcript pane says 'まだ発話がありません' (no speech yet) and the decisions/todos sections are both showing placeholder 'waiting for...' text. It is waiting for someone to actually speak.
answers.q4: The recording status indicator (録音中 / 00:02 / listening state) — it's the one piece of information confirming the app is actively capturing the meeting right now.
answers.q5: The generic '23:32 の会議' title is unclear since it identifies no real meeting; 'AI が見ている資料' at the bottom is unclear/unnecessary in this state since no material is shown or named; having three separate empty-state messages (聞いています..., 決まったことを待っています..., やることを待っています...) feels redundant when one 'waiting for speech' state would cover it.

weaknesses.what: The top pill toolbar (pause/comment/expand/more/stop) overlaps and floats above the main panel with its own shadow, visually detaching it from the rest of the interface like a separate floating control strip.
weaknesses.fix: Dock the toolbar flush into the main panel's top edge, or remove the shadow/gap so it reads as one continuous frame.

weaknesses.what: No meeting title, calendar source, or participant info is shown — only a generic time-based label — so a first-time viewer cannot tell what meeting or source this is.
weaknesses.fix: Pull in the real meeting/event title or participant names when available, or clearly label it as an ad-hoc/untitled recording.

weaknesses.what: Three separate placeholder 'waiting for...' messages (listening, decisions, todos) make the screen feel empty and repetitive before anything has happened.
weaknesses.fix: Collapse the empty states into a single lighter-weight waiting indicator until real content starts flowing in.
